About Us

Nurturing young learners with care and creativity

Happy Feet is an independent Pre-K institution in Pohkseh, Shillong. Since March 2012, we've dedicated ourselves to nurturing children aged 3–5 — shaping young minds into resilient, curious, and confident individuals ready for the world ahead.

We go beyond ordinary playschool. Happy Feet is a secure, welcoming haven where children flourish through engaging, developmentally appropriate activities — balancing structured learning with the freedom to play and explore.

👩‍🏫
Experienced & Caring Teachers

  • Child-centred learning approach
  • Early education specialists
  • Warm, nurturing environment

🤝
Strong Parent Communication

  • Focus on creativity & imagination
  • Clean, safe and joyful space
  • Separation anxiety support

Our Programmes

Our early learning programmes designed for growth

👶
Ages 3 and above

Nursery Programme

Our Nursery programme is where your child's school journey begins. Through play-based learning, gentle routines, and warm teacher relationships, children build confidence, social skills, and a genuine love of learning — ready for the next step ahead.

Apply for Nursery
📚
Progressing from Nursery

Lower KG

Lower KG builds on the foundations laid in Nursery, developing language, cognitive, and social skills in a more structured environment. Children grow in confidence and independence — fully prepared for the transition into formal primary school.

Life at Happy Feet

A glimpse into our world

Admissions 2025–2026

How to join the Happy Feet family

Applications for the coming academic year are accepted online only. Places are limited and offered based on availability, suitability, and age appropriateness — so we encourage early applications.

1

Submit your online application

Fill in and submit the Nursery application form via our website. All admissions are processed online — we do not accept walk-in applications.

2

Application reviewed

Once received, our team reviews the application based on availability, age suitability, and appropriateness. We'll be in touch with the outcome and next steps.

3

Complete enrolment procedures

Approved families complete the required enrolment steps and receive the Happy Feet Handbook — your comprehensive guide to school life, fees, and policies.

4

Welcome to Happy Feet! 🎉

Your child joins our warm, nurturing community — ready to explore, play, laugh, and grow with us every day.

Our Philosophy

Learning that comes from doing

At Happy Feet, we hold the conviction that every child holds the potential to succeed when provided with the chance. Our curriculum is built around firsthand experience — because children learn deepest when they're engaged, curious, and having fun.

We strike a harmonious balance between structured activities and unstructured play across all age groups, ensuring children are content and thriving as they follow their passions.

🎨 Play-based learning 🌿 Sensory exploration 🤝 Social development 💪 Motor skills 📖 School readiness ❤️ Emotional resilience
🎨

Creative & play-based curriculum

Art, music, storytelling, and hands-on activities are woven into every school day — stimulating imagination and nurturing a genuine love of learning from the very start.

🏃

Whole-child development

Our activities are designed to enhance gross motor skills, refine fine motor control, and heighten sensory perception — developing the whole child, not just academic ability.

🎓

Ready for formal school

When children leave Happy Feet, they carry self-assurance, strong interpersonal skills, and a well-developed vocabulary — confident and fully prepared for Class 1 and beyond.
